title: SEND IT PARK
first_action: Ready rail, tap Send It; immediate downward ride and rider acting. Edit glowing height nodes to reach optional stamps; hold brake on sharp turns.
reference: Rezona Roller Coaster gallery actual pointer-drawn line, ride camera, Stop Ride observed. Not a full reference finish or source adaptation.
dedup: No prior roller coaster or user-sculpted rail/active curvature braking found. Crayon Courier draws rigid-body bridges/weights for a ball; Tiny Railway switches routes; Cart Riot steers a hopping cart and smashes crates. These are acknowledged related movement/drawing games. No extraction tower, sticky-growth, suction or office loop.

skills.game-design: Fast default first ride, direct geometry edits, free rebuild, new structural goals and best-only stamps.
skills.game-art: One rounded coral/mint/lavender fairground, expressive human riders and function-linked props.
skills.3d-games: Original Three geometry; arc-length constrained rail model, camera follow and bounded instancing.
skills.web-games: Local pinned library, self-contained classic HTML, no runtime CDN.
skills.mobile-games: 44px buttons, pointer cancellation, portrait/landscape, pause and restore.
skills.game-audio: Short layered rail clicks, brakes and varying celebratory synth tones; muted play readable.

revision: User rejected the first art pass as rough, then explicitly chose to retain the coaster and completely rebuild art and feel.
art_rebuild: Seated articulated riders, smooth heads/ears/eyes/nose/hair/cap/clothes/hands/boots; enamel shells, ribbed cushions, safety bars, couplers and rotating wheel groups; trestle frames, footings, textured boardwalk, marquees, benches and planting. Ink/brass instruments replace heavy pastel panels.
feel_rebuild: Finger offset compensation, camera held during rail drag, spring body/head lag, speed-dependent acting, advance braking/arch warnings, pressed brake state, rolling/brake sound layers and quieter reward toast.
performance: Static geometry and wheel parts merged; cached static sun shadows, dynamic soft carriage blobs, Full/Light and Gentle. Observed local steady scene budget74drawcalls/121883triangles; not physical handset FPS.
